callback_per_stage_optimizer

Source: R/utilities.R
callback_per_stage_optimizer.Rd

Replace the luz optimizer with per-stage parameter groups at the start of training.

Usage

callback_per_stage_optimizer(optimizer_fn = torch::optim_adamw, ...)

Arguments

optimizer_fn

Optimizer constructor function. Defaults to torch::optim_adamw. Any torch optimizer that accepts a list of parameter groups as its first argument can be used.

...

Additional arguments forwarded to optimizer_fn, such as weight_decay.

Value

A luz callback object.

Details

A luz callback that calls model$get_param_groups() on the instantiated model at the start of fit() and replaces the default flat-parameter optimizer with one built from the per-stage parameter groups. This allows different learning rates to be assigned to different stages of the network when using models that support stageLRs (e.g. defineUNet, defineMobileUNet, defineUNet3p, defineEfficientUNetB2).

This callback must be placed before any learning rate scheduler callback in the callbacks list so that the scheduler is initialised against the per-stage optimizer rather than the original flat one.

When using torch::lr_one_cycle alongside this callback, pass max_lr, max_momentum, and base_momentum as vectors of length equal to the number of stages so that the scheduler can assign per-group values. A proportionally scaled max_lr vector can be constructed as stage_lrs / max(stage_lrs) * global_max_lr.
